title: Marketing for AI games/apps?
author: kingkongy
selftext:
Hey all! I have been 'vibe coding' for about 8 months now, since March of this year. I did take a 3 month break starting in May due to hitting a wall and going on vacation for summer months. When I picked back up, it was full go. I have games already released in the stores (I have links below if interested in what they look like). 

My real question is, after all the work, how do you guys get the views for the games and apps? I feel like posting on subs isn't really giving it enough views. What do you all do to get clicks? cost/click for ads is pretty outrageous so I'm not sure if I want to go the advertising route. 

Is there a cheaper way to get views? I don't mind paying. I also am not sure if this is going to be worth it long term, as this is a side hobby that randomly became something I've polished enough to sell. 

As mentioned above, my apps and games are below:  
[Ante - Android Game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kongylabs.ante)

[Fallen Heroes - JRPG](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p320khp8tc3?hl=en-US&gl=US)

[Sports mini Game (more slop)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kongylabs.sportsclub)

I have apps too, but not going to post those since this is "gamedev"

replies.author: zayelion
replies.body: Depends on the game. I've seen as high as 25 usd a user and as low as 2.50 a user.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/kingkongy please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.
